avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immunosuppression and reduce monoclonal antibody efficacy through immune modulation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult oncologist before initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulant that may interfere with targeted HER2 therapy mechanism or increase adverse cardiac effects
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue during pertuzumab treatment; consider safer immune support alternatives

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild immunomodulatory effects that could theoretically interfere with monoclonal antibody therapy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; discuss with oncology team before use

caution_supplements.name: CoQ10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May provide cardiac protection given pertuzumab's potential for cardiomyopathy, though evidence is limited
caution_supplements.action: Can be considered with medical supervision; inform healthcare team of use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: No direct metabolic interaction, but may increase GI side effects in some patients on biologics
avoid_foods.action: Limit consumption; not absolute contraindication but best avoided

caution_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium may exacerbate fluid retention and cardiac complications related to HER2 inhibition
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake; especially important if baseline cardiac risk factors present

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>moderate amounts)
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase cardiotoxicity risk when combined with pertuzumab; dehydration concern
caution_foods.action: Limit to ≤1 drink/day; ensure adequate hydration and discuss with oncology team

monitoring_notes: Pertuzumab is a monoclonal antibody not metabolized via CYP450 pathways, minimizing traditional drug interactions; primary concern is cardiac monitoring (LVEF assessment) and immune function preservation. Counsel patients to report any supplements or herbal products and maintain cardiology follow-up, particularly regarding HER2-mediated cardiomyopathy risk.
